variables.name: GRAFANA_URL
variables.title: Grafana instance URL
variables.description: Your Grafana instance URL. For Grafana Cloud: https://<stack>.grafana.net. For self-hosted: e.g. http://localhost:3000.

variables.name: GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
variables.title: Grafana service account token
variables.description: Create a service account token at <your-grafana-url>/org/serviceaccounts with at least Viewer role (Editor for write operations).
